source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of graph properties (PDF 113-114).

items: Degree: kisi vertex se jure edges ki tadaad; teen shehron se jura shehar degree 3.
Weight: edge par qeemat jaise faasla ya laagat; 50 km sarak ka weight 50 ho sakta hai.
Direction: directed edges ek taraf (A se B ki sarak ka wapas aana zaroori nahi), undirected edges dono taraf.
